Standard: An intercom system is accessible for immediate use at any crew station and provides two-way communication between crewmembers in all compartments. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review engineering drawings or digital models to verify that controls to activate the intercom system are located at each crew station in a position so that the intended anthropometric range of crewmembers can activate the system.
(2) Examine crew stations to verify that controls to activate the intercom system are located at each crew station in a position so that the intended anthropometric range of crewmembers can activate the system. Demonstration.
  (1) Demonstrate in a production representative mock-up or on the air vehicle that the intercom system provides two-way communication between crewmembers in all compartments.
